svg.title: hcom arch: blank Architect plus in-process Developer/Reviewer supervisor
svg.desc: The human types the first prompt into a blank interactive Architect, inspects and approves a typed plan, then an in-process supervisor runs a fresh no-TUI Developer and Reviewer(s) per task, resuming exact sessions for corrections until LGTM or the round budget, and auto-advances to the next task.

text.tspan: hcom arch — talk to one blank Architect; a supervisor drives Developer → Reviewer for every task
You type the first prompt yourself. Nothing starts until you approve the typed plan. Workers are fresh no-TUI sessions that end with the Architect.
